{{Quote|Nok Drayen was the greatest gangster who ever lived. He personally wiped out the Rath Cartel and the Vandelhelm Combine during the Syndicate Wars.|[[Risha Drayen]]|<ref name="Race" />}}
The '''Syndicate Wars''' were a series of campaigns in which the gangster [[Nok Drayen]] destroyed many of his powerful rivals in the underworld. The most famous examples include the [[Rath Cartel]] and the [[Vandelhelm Combine]].<ref name="Race" /> The [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Jakarro]] used his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to raid rival [[Transport/Legends|transports]] during the Syndicate Wars.<ref name="Jakarro">{{TORcite|type=codex|Jakarro}}</ref>
